Buying guide and item details

Compare an actual collection rather than headline counts

An account advertising X-Suits, Mythics and Gun Labs may be describing three different measurements. The number of outfits is not the number of fully upgraded weapons, and a Level 7 M416 is not interchangeable with a Level 1 finish of the same name. Compare the exact item name, upgrade stage and visible inventory evidence separately before you place any value on a collection.

Use listing images as clues to investigate, not guaranteed proof of current ownership. A static screenshot can be old, cropped or reused. When a description leaves an item level blank, treat that level as unknown rather than assuming the best upgrade stage.

M416 Glacier, X-Suits, vehicles and seasonal records

Glacier M416, other upgradeable firearms and named X-Suits have different progression paths. Review the claimed stage, whether an effect is included at that stage and how the listing describes the collection. Vehicle cosmetics should identify their exact finish rather than only a brand name. Older season badges and Conqueror titles describe historical rank achievements, not the present ability to transfer an account.

Price comparisons are only meaningful when listings describe comparable items. A cheaper profile with fewer upgraded cosmetics can suit a different collector than one with several high-stage X-Suits. A long marketing title alone is not enough information.

Account policy and security matter worldwide

PUBG Mobile's published account rules restrict gifting, lending and transferring accounts. Publisher enforcement and recovery risks cannot be removed by a marketplace headline, warranty phrase or seller promise. Before relying on any listing, understand those restrictions and do not share passwords, linked-email access, device approval codes or recovery details with an unverified party.

Regional access, server history and account security may differ from one profile to another. Never treat a tag such as GLOBAL as proof that every region or payment arrangement is supported. Ask precise questions and avoid assuming that screenshots establish permanent control.
